findings.title: Keep the threaded-flux result variational; it does not establish a positive magnetic stiffness
findings.reason: The code inserts measured n_f into a supplied trial-state cosine formula. Its normalized 1/L ratio cancels n_f. A positive variational expectation is an upper bound, not a lower bound on the lowest energy in a physical magnetic-flux sector. Independent construction of the actual 864-state twisted vector gives E=8/3, variance=44/9, overlap squared with the zero-energy RK ground state=1/16. Thus it is not an eigenstate energy; no orthogonal magnetic-sector identification or lower bound has been established. The cited source calls K≈n_f J a rough estimate. The downstream note presently promotes this to proved positive K and a proved positive UK product.
findings.minimal_fix: Retain the exact trial-state expectation, measured finite n_f ladder and conditional effective curl theorem. Identify any positive renormalized K/stable-phase assertion as the external effective-phase input, not an independently proved runner conclusion. Propagate the distinction through headings, result arrows, contribution/N1/N4/N8 claims and certificates in both notes/runners. Add or reuse a concrete finite trial-state check so the observable definition is reviewable; no demand for a new thermodynamic lower-bound theorem.

findings.title: Separate connected-component derivatives and finite sampling fits from sector ground-energy claims
findings.reason: At RK, each connected component provides a separate zero state. For negative deltaV the flux-sector ground branch maximizes component mean flippability; it is not generally the uniform mean of every configuration in that flux sector. The exact L2 zero-flux whole-sector mean is 432/55, while the selected864-state component mean is 8. The larger-volume chain only reaches its initialized component. Its finite burn-in, block errors and symmetry pooling do not establish whole-sector connectivity, maximal-component selection or a rigorous bound on the actual sector derivative. The existing mixing/all-orders caveats are good but do not qualify the front-facing claim that the physical coefficient has been established.
findings.minimal_fix: State E_Phi(deltaV)=deltaV max_{C in Phi}<N_f>_C+O(deltaV²) for deltaV<0 at fixed finite L, and distinguish a chosen RK component branch. Keep the exact L2 theorem. Label c_L and2c as finite-protocol estimates/Maxwell-normalized fit parameters, conditional on the sampling/sector identification needed to infer microscopic U. Preserve the explicit nominal-block-error and noninterchangeable-limit caveats. Do not require a new whole-sector ergodicity theorem or mislabel the fit as a negative result.
